The goal of the simulation is to deal the most damage to other cars.  Damage is dealt by colliding with other cars but each car has specific vulerable points that, if damaged, will affect how the car drives. Front wheels controls steering ability. Rear wheels, engine, drive shaft, control acceleration.  If a car's engine health hit's 0 it will explode dealing damage to all nearby cars.
